name: 13502 · Utica, NY
findings: ZIP 13502 (Utica) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13502 (Utica) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13502 (Utica) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.
